tools.name: open_demo_request_form
tools.description: Open Guild.ai's demo request form on this page with the details below already filled in, so the person reading the page can check them and submit it themselves. This does not send anything: nothing reaches Guild until they press Submit, and the form asks them a few more questions first. Call it when they have said they want a demo. Pricing is discussed on the call.

email.description: The requester's work email address. Guild follows up here.
